title: Pure Laval
match: Soaring Eagle Above the Searing Land
summary: Pure Laval FIRE Synchro build with Shooting Quasar Dragon and generic staples. The deck rapidly dumps five or more Laval monsters into the GY with Molten Conduction Field and Laval Volcano Handmaiden to turn on free extenders, multi-Tuner revivals, and Level 5 to 12 Synchro climbs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Molten Conduction Field sends two Laval monsters with different names from your Deck to the GY; sending Laval Volcano Handmaiden plus another Laval triggers Handmaiden to chain-mill up to three Handmaidens and a fifth Laval name from a single Spell.
Laval Archer grants an additional Normal Summon of a Laval monster on Normal Summon, and revives itself from the GY in Defense Position by destroying a FIRE monster you control.
Laval Coatl (Level 2 Tuner) and Laval Burner (Level 5 non-Tuner) Special Summon themselves from the hand once you have three or more Laval monsters with different names in your GY.
Laval Cannon Normal Summons to Special Summon a banished Laval monster, pairing with Laval Lancelord or Kayenn, the Master Magma Blacksmith.

summary.title: Opening: Molten Conduction Field + Laval Archer
steps: Activate Molten Conduction Field to send Laval Volcano Handmaiden and Laval Lakeside Lady (or Laval Phlogis) from the Deck to the GY; chain Handmaiden three times to send all three copies of Handmaiden plus a fourth Laval monster, loading five Lavals into the GY at once.
Normal Summon Laval Archer to gain an extra Laval Normal Summon, or destroy a FIRE monster from the GY with Archer to revive it and Special Summon Laval Coatl from your hand.

Climb through Level 6 Lavalval Dragun (which searches a Laval and discards one) into Level 7 Lavalval Salamander (to draw two cards) or Level 8 Lavalval Exlord, or banish Lavals from the GY with Searing Fire Wall to spawn Laval Tokens for Shooting Quasar Dragon.

summary.title: Graveyard Thresholds & Token Swarm
summary.text: Having three or more different Laval names in the GY unlocks Laval Coatl, Laval Burner, Soaring Eagle Above the Searing Land, and Laval Lakeside Lady's GY effect to banish itself and another Laval to destroy a Set card. Searing Fire Wall banishes any number of Laval monsters from your GY at Quick-Play speed to Special Summon that many Level 1 FIRE Laval Tokens, providing exact non-Tuner levels for Synchro climbing while setting up Laval Cannon.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Lavalval Exlord (Level 8 Synchro) destroys an opposing monster on the field or in the hand when it activates its effect and burns for 1000 damage, and when destroyed by the opponent, it Special Summons up to three non-Synchro FIRE monsters with 200 DEF from your GY.

Lavalval Salamander (Level 7 Synchro) draws two cards and sends two cards (including a FIRE monster) from your hand to the GY on Synchro Summon, and banishes a FIRE monster from your GY once per turn to flip opposing monsters face-down.

Laval Stennon negates targeting effects by banishing a Laval from the GY, Lavalval Dragon shuffles two Lavals from the GY into the Deck to bounce an opposing card, and Shooting Quasar Dragon caps multi-Synchro hands with an omni-negate and multiple attacks.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Lavalval Chain is Forbidden in the TCG.
